critique: The twelve alternating bowling lanes, mustard boards, teal gutters, and multicoloured rolling balls turn a familiar alley into a buoyant, high-key kinetic pattern with convincing mid-century optimism. The rigid lane grid overwhelms the requested organic curves, while the tiny corner guinea pig is too inconsequential to become a meaningful surprise; enlarging it into an active participant or replacing it with bold atomic-age forms would sharpen the concept.
